svg.title: Judah within the Persian Empire
svg.desc: Judah within the Persian Empire. Geographic orientation map with land, water, coastlines, rivers, and these places: Jerusalem, known location; Babylon, known location; Susa, known location. This map shows the great distance between Jerusalem, Babylon, and Susa. The returnees did not all travel by one recorded route.

text.tspan: This map shows the great distance between Jerusalem, Babylon, and Susa. The returnees did not all travel
Modern coastlines and rivers are shown for orientation; no unrecorded route or ancient border is claimed.
